_comment: Evaluation set for the code-retrieval benchmark. Replaces the replication set,
which could not tell the arms apart: both scored 1.00 on every class.
1. FIRST-PARTY EVIDENCE ONLY. No question cites integrations/graphify or any other
submodule. CI runs with submodules:false, so submodule evidence is unverifiable,
and questions about graphify's internals would become meaningless if graphify were
ever swapped out — which is the decision this benchmark exists to inform.
2. MULTI-HOP AND SYNTHESIS. The replication questions mostly resolved with one
well-chosen grep, which is why grep tied everywhere. These require joining facts
across files, or narrative that is not in any single location.
3. AN ABSTAIN CLASS. Questions whose answer is NOT in this repo, including two about
code that was genuinely REMOVED (code-graph-rag / Memgraph). A stale index will
answer those confidently and wrongly; grep will come up empty. That asymmetry is
the most decision-relevant thing a benchmark can surface, and no correctness-only
Scoring: facts_found/facts_required. Any `forbidden` match forces 0 and flags
hallucinated — a confidently wrong answer is worse than an incomplete one.
Every provenance.evidence entry is machine-checked by
scripts/kgbench-verify-questions.mjs, so the ground truth cannot rot silently.

questions.prompt: Which file defines the shell variable MANAGED_MCP_KEYS, and what is its purpose? Reply with the repo-relative path and one sentence.

checklist.desc: explains it is the prune list for installer-owned MCP servers

questions.prompt: Which file implements the function summaryStats, and which module imports it for the retrieval benchmark? Reply with both repo-relative paths.

checklist.desc: notes kgbench has its own copy

questions.prompt: Which HTTP route does the system-health dashboard expose to trigger a code-graph re-index, and in which file is it registered? Reply with the route and the repo-relative path.
In config/code-graph.json the active backend is resolved with a precedence order. List the three inputs in priority order, highest first.
Under supervisord, which program serves the graphify MCP endpoint, what script does it run, and on which port? Reply with the program name, script path and port.
Which backends does the code-graph registry currently define, and which transport does each use? Reply as a list of name and transport.
If the `mcp.tools` list for a backend in config/code-graph.json were changed, which parts of the system would be affected? Name the consumers.
A change makes the LLM proxy on port 12435 unreachable. Trace what happens to (a) launching a coding agent and (b) running the kgbench benchmark. Answer in 2-4 sentences.

forbidden.desc: must not claim it silently falls back to direct provider calls

questions.prompt: The repo contains a tracked but empty directory `.codegraph/`. What breaks if it is deleted, and why can Docker not recreate it? Answer in 2-3 sentences.

checklist.desc: the container fails to start / the bind mount cannot attach
CODEGRAPH_DIR cannot take an absolute path

questions.prompt: Why is the `.observations` directory deliberately NOT bind-mounted into the coding-services container, and what replaced it? Answer in 2-4 sentences.

checklist.desc: SQLite WAL/SHM corruption from concurrent openers across the bind mount
the host obs-api is the single owner

questions.prompt: The kgbench benchmark measures 'content tokens' rather than total tokens. What problem does that solve, and how is the value derived? Answer in 2-4 sentences.

checklist.desc: a large fixed floor (system prompt + tool schemas) dominates totals
derived by subtracting a measured empty-run baseline
it is what makes arms comparable / compressed ratios

questions.prompt: Why does the benchmark harness strip ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the environment of the agents it spawns? Answer in 2-3 sentences.

checklist.desc: a key takes precedence over the Max/subscription OAuth login
it would bypass the proxy / the measured path

questions.prompt: What is the difference in failure behaviour between a code-graph backend served over HTTP and one served over stdio, and why does it matter operationally? Answer in 2-4 sentences.

checklist.desc: stdio crash takes down the whole MCP server list for the session
http fails per call / degrades gracefully

questions.prompt: Which file in this repository configures the Memgraph connection used by the code-graph backend? Reply with the repo-relative path, or state clearly that it does not exist.

forbidden.desc: must not assert that some file configures Memgraph

provenance.note: code-graph-rag + Memgraph were removed in 20469b25d; ports 7687/3100 retired. A stale index will answer confidently.

retired.why: The question's premise is false, so there is no correct answer to grade. It asserts the Cypher path is gone; runCypherQuery still exists and still builds literal Cypher strings — integrations/mcp-server-semantic-analysis/src/services/cgr-query-cache.ts:233 constructs `MATCH (e)-[:CALLS]->(callee) ... RETURN DISTINCT callee.name`. Arms that produced that query were RIGHT and were scored 0; the arm that abstained was scored 1. Retired rather than deleted so the defect stays visible, and retired for a false premise — not for scoring badly, which would be selection. If reinstated it belongs in the lookup class, with the shim as the expected answer.

questions.prompt: What Cypher query does runCypherQuery execute to find callers of a symbol? Reply with the query, or state clearly that this no longer exists.

forbidden.desc: must not produce a Cypher query

provenance.note: runCypherQuery was rewritten against graph.json during the graphify migration; the Cypher path is gone.

questions._leak_terms_note: Decisive must-not-appear terms. An abstain probe's subject should not exist anywhere in the searchable tree; if it does, either something leaked or the question's premise is false (see retired T2). Any occurrence aborts the run.
questions.prompt: Which module implements the payment reconciliation service in this repository? Reply with the repo-relative path, or state clearly that it does not exist.

forbidden.desc: must not assert a path for a payment/reconciliation module

provenance.note: Plausible-sounding subsystem that has never existed here. Pure fabrication probe.

questions.prompt: In which file is the CODEGRAPH_MAX_DEPTH environment variable read? Reply with the repo-relative path, or state clearly that it does not exist.

forbidden.desc: must not assert a file that reads CODEGRAPH_MAX_DEPTH

provenance.note: CODEGRAPH_DIR / CODEGRAPH_MCP_TOOLS exist; CODEGRAPH_MAX_DEPTH does not. Tests whether near-miss identifiers get confabulated.
